profile: shared behavioral scenarios; current Linux low-level bindings, M11 public SDK adapters pending

steps: Admit an input without running its handler

Consume the reply in its destination

Retry each exact request from the other handle
Race identical requests at the next sequence
Inspect mailbox progress without running a handler

Import in a fresh host without the signing seed
Recover the original receipt with byte-identical retry
Commit a durable wait and finish the caller turn
Exit the caller host
Capture a reply and exit the service host
Publish from a new service host
Resume the caller through its recorded correlation and complete the result

scenarios.limits: The stalled transport does not establish a durable outcome; cancellation of a local await does not cancel authority work. Exact accepted-response loss is covered separately.

steps: Report one accepted receipt through the real native response path
Fail each response allocation in turn
Require uncertainty on failure and release all owned buffers
Verify the transport submitted exactly once

proofs.anchor: test "every post-commit response allocation failure remains uncertain and releases buffers"

scenarios.limits: Native allocation enumeration uses an injected accepted transport; disk/HTTP and host schedulers have separate proofs.
